content.thinking: The connection close parser has the call split across lines. Note: a truncated reason must be an error — with `parseByteArrayField` it throws EndOfStreamException only when it can't read... Actually `parseByteArrayField(n)` reads n bytes; if fewer are available → EndOfStreamException ✓. But the `.intValue()` narrowing for huge declared lengths could turn negative → ParserException ✓ also an error. Still, `parseLongByteArrayField` is cleaner. Let me apply the remaining two patches.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/submission/src && python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib
R=pathlib.Path('/workspace/submission/src')
p=R/'de/rub/nds/tlsattacker/core/quic/parser/frame/ConnectionCloseFrameParser.java'
s=open(p).read()
old="""        frame.setReasonPhrase(
                parseByteArrayField(frame.getReasonPhraseLength().getValue().intValue()));"""
new="""        frame.setReasonPhrase(parseLongByteArrayField(frame.getReasonPhraseLength().getValue()));"""
assert old in s
open(p,'w').write(s.replace(old,new,1))

p=R/'de/rub/nds/tlsattacker/core/quic/serializer/frame/ConnectionCloseFrameSerializer.java'
s=open(p).read()
old="""    private void writeReasonPhraseLength() {
        if (frame.getReasonPhraseLength() != null
                && frame.getReasonPhraseLength().getValue() != null) {
            appendBytes(
                    VariableLengthIntegerEncoding.encodeVariableLengthInteger(
                            frame.getReasonPhraseLength().getValue()));
            LOGGER.debug("Reason Phrase Length: {}", frame.getReasonPhraseLength().getValue());
        }
    }"""
new="""    /** The reason phrase length field always exists; it defaults to the phrase size. */
    private void writeReasonPhraseLength() {
        long length =
                frame.getReasonPhraseLength() == null
                                || frame.getReasonPhraseLength().getValue() == null
                        ? (frame.getReasonPhrase() == null
                                        || frame.getReasonPhrase().getValue() == null
                                ? 0
                                : frame.getReasonPhrase().getValue().length)
                        : frame.getReasonPhraseLength().getValue();
        appendBytes(VariableLengthIntegerEncoding.encodeVariableLengthInteger(length));
        LOGGER.debug("Reason Phrase Length: {}", length);
    }"""
assert old in s
open(p,'w').write(s.replace(old,new,1))
print('ok')
